selected_stage_definition: Implementation DAG, execution order, computational platform, parallelization and checkpoints only. Source-admission calculations are planned but not executed in this stage.

legacy_authority.policy: Read-only provenance; never reused as sharp output.

implementation_seams.tov_limit: oscillation_source/solutions/src/structure/ns_maxwell_tov.f90 currently accepts two callbacks and one sharp interface

thermodynamic_convention.il0_q3: mn*(1+Q3)=mu_E-Yq*mn*Q4; recover mu_E by adding Yq*mn*Q4 before the P(mu_E) phase validation
thermodynamic_convention.il1_q3: mn*(1+Q3)=mu_E for supported cold beta-equilibrated Q5≈0 branch
thermodynamic_convention.root_coordinate: mu_E=(epsilon+P)/n_B; never use charge-shifted raw Q3 as the Maxwell root coordinate

stellar_maxwell.provenance: Imported from PR #3 head a09ec30d74b363652d2d1aefe990557c468679dd into PR #1 branch; native validation pending exact-head CI.

dag.name: Freeze exact input/source identity
gate: Pin source branch and commit
Verify 52 input blob SHAs
Verify 65 unique pair IDs and immutable legacy paths

dag.name: Read 18 CompOSE sources through existing native reader
gate: Use compose_eos.api.read_compose / Fortran read_compose
Retain Nadd/q_extra, Iphase and composition data
Record row counts and (iT,inb,iYq) coverage

dag.name: Structural and metadata audit
gate: Finite values and row widths
Strict key coverage and selected T/Yq slice
Composition record shapes and exact phase boundaries

dag.name: Thermodynamic and beta-equilibrium audit
gate: P=n_B*Q1; epsilon=n_B*mn*(1+Q7); mu_E=(epsilon+P)/n_B
Q3 is Il-dependent: Il=0 -> mn*(1+Q3)=mu_E-Yq*mn*Q4; Il=1,Q5≈0 -> mn*(1+Q3)=mu_E
The true Maxwell root variable is Euler mu_E; preserve stored CompOSE Q3 convention in outputs
Report Q2, Q5, Q6-Q7 and corrected Q3/Euler residual separately
Keep the strict source-admission/reconstruction Q3-Euler tolerance 2e-6 distinct from the true-Maxwell v1 kernel local input tolerance 5e-4; do not interchange or loosen
Keep exact mass-rest-energy convention source-specific until an explicit conversion is recorded

dag.name: Composition and provider-semantics audit
gate: Check charge and baryon closure
Retain raw YI and test Yh=Abar*YI
Resolve provider Data Sheet meanings for Iphase/Nadd or leave unresolved

dag.name: Segmentwise whole-interval stability and causality
gate: Split at every Iphase boundary
Never differentiate/interpolate across a source boundary
Use analytic Hermite extrema for n>0, dn/dmu>0 and 0<cs2/c2<=1
Report full source and connected causal-domain results separately

dag.name: Density reconstruction and 65-pair compatibility
gate: Record reconstructed_n_max_rel without inventing threshold
Check T/Yq/Il, neutrality, mass conventions and common mu support
Create all 65 pair records without running roots

dag.name: Segment-preserving adapter intermediate representation
gate: Keep raw source immutable
Represent each smooth Iphase segment separately
Every projection/drop must have reversible provenance and documented semantic authority

dag.name: EOS reconstruction, smooth matching and true-Maxwell kernel validation
gate: Re-read native reconstruct_master source and verify F(log n_B), P=n_B F', epsilon=n_B F, mu_E=F+F', and c_s^2/c^2=(F'+F'')/(F+F')
Verify Il-aware Q3 convention for Il=0 and supported Il=1,Q5≈0 in source validation, master reconstruction output and true-Maxwell input/output
Verify strict source/reconstruction tolerance 2e-6 is not silently replaced by the true-Maxwell v1 local Q3 tolerance 5e-4
Run and retain regressions for all six smooth methods maxwell/css/cubic_F/cubic_P/quintic_F/quintic_P on the documented analytic/source fixtures
Assert historical match_crust_core(method=maxwell) is smooth_near_pressure_plateau with zero density jump, is_exact_maxwell=false and seidov_applicable=false
Run true-Maxwell Il=0 and Il=1 analytic two-phase fixtures; require equal P and Euler mu, positive density jump, Delta epsilon=mu_t*Delta n_B, and native C2/overall output consistency

Test root-topology controls: non-overlapping mu support, no crossing, one transverse crossing, tangential crossing, multiple crossings and duplicate endpoint roots; keep exactly-one-root promotion rule
Test whole-interval Hermite n>0, dn/dmu>0 and mu*dn/dmu-n>=0 using exact polynomial extrema, not sampled diagnostics
Test rejection of Q5!=0, composition-bearing, Nadd!=0, internal Iphase discontinuity, incompatible masses and incompatible Il/Yq metadata
Do not run any of the 65 cohort root searches or production TOV/Cowling

result_policy.current_il0_fix: TDD_RED_GREEN_REPRODUCED_IN_EXPORTED_PR1_SOURCE_ARTIFACT; 68 frontend/pipeline tests passed locally; local run directory has no Git metadata

dag.name: One-pair sharp-Maxwell pilot
gate: Isolate all pressure roots/stationary points
Require exactly one root for promotion
Independently verify common P, common mu and Delta epsilon=mu_t Delta n_B

dag.name: 65-pair sharp-Maxwell sweep
gate: Exactly 65 unique terminal statuses
Keep NO_ROOT/MULTIPLE_ROOT/INPUT_REJECTED/ACAUSAL
Never write into legacy maxwell paths

dag.name: Phase-chain TOV, stable branch and Cowling spectra
gate: Use two phase EOS providers with common Maxwell pressure and Euler mu_t; integrate core and envelope as separate segments and meet exact P_t, never interpolate across the density jump
Use native integrate_maxwell_tov and production solve_tov_star path; compare against the independent Python/SciPy MaxwellEOS reference on the same analytic fixtures
Use native shoot_maxwell_cowling and scan_maxwell_modes; compare interface transfer against independent Python/SciPy reference for slow/material and rapid conversion separately
Verify slow: [xi^r]=[Delta P]=0; rapid: [Delta P]=0 and [xi^r-Delta P/P'_0]=0 under the exact interface convention documented in MAXWELL_TOV_COWLING_INTERFACE_V1.md
Retain one-sided inner/outer state values; no averaging or derivative stencil across the interface
Run TOV interface-pressure continuity, mass/radius and interface-radius convergence before mode spectra
Check stable branch and Seidov onset diagnostic separately; do not interpret Seidov criterion as a universal stability test outside its GR assumptions
Run independent ODE tolerance and root-grid refinement for each conversion mode; do not merge slow/rapid mode lists
Root ordering is only numerical matching; mode-family identity is unresolved outside the documented small-jump smooth-limit cross-match
Preserve NO_ROOT/MULTIPLE_ROOT/ACAUSAL/UNSTABLE_ONSET/NUMERICAL_INCONCLUSIVE as distinct statuses
Run native maxwell_checks and maxwell_table_checks plus Python test_maxwell_star and validate_native_maxwell_reference
Do not claim full stable-branch maximum-mass, complete GR polar modes, damping, realistic EOS cohort predictions or production CompOSE composition

resources.platform: CPU-only Linux (GitHub ubuntu-latest and user WSL/Linux)
resources.python: Python 3.13 in current Maxwell CI workflow; project minimum Python >=3.10
resources.memory_budget: 2 GiB planning ceiling, not a measured peak; arrays scale O(N_knots)
resources.parallelism: Initial serial deterministic run; after parser parity, max 4 independent source workers locally and max 2 on shared CI; one coordinator alone writes aggregate manifests
resources.why_cpu: 52 source files total 1,594,597 bytes and 6,214 thermodynamic knots; parsing, algebraic closure and Hermite extrema are CPU tasks.

checkpoints.when: Reader vertical slice passes on SPG_M1 and one Nadd=1 GPPVA

fields: Il-dependent Q3/Euler relation (Il=0 charge-shift; Il=1,Q5≈0 equality)
all six smooth matching method receipts and exact non-Maxwell semantics
true Maxwell Il=0/Il=1 coexistence and latent-energy receipts
separate 2e-6 source/reconstruction and 5e-4 Maxwell v1 local thresholds

checkpoints.when: Before one-pair true-Maxwell pilot; after C4-D0 identity and code/test replay
fields: TDD RED/GREEN output for Il=0 Q3 regression
master first-law and causal polynomial-extrema results
six smooth method distinct semantics and differential results
true Maxwell Il=0/Il=1 fixture P/mu/jump/latent-heat/C2 closure
rejection controls and full test inventory

ci_plan.gap: PR #3 workflow pull_request filter targets research/maxwell-reference-validation-v1 while PR #4 base is research/maxwell-native-fortran-v1; it also checks out the fixed PR #3 branch. It cannot establish PR #4 head validity as configured.
ci_plan.checkout: Use event PR head/merge SHA; do not hardcode branch.
checks: assert zero Maxwell roots and zero TOV/Cowling in source-audit job

delegation.reason: No native spawn/create/wait lifecycle was exposed in the live host inventory; no simulated delegation.
delegation.execution: Serial parent/coordinator; bounded process parallelism only after parser determinism is established.

mutation_policy.M0: READ_ONLY: inspect/fetch/test only; stop if branch/worktree identity is dirty or ambiguous
mutation_policy.M1: RESEARCH_ONLY: edits limited to existing EOS implementation branch code/tests/docs and this existing C4 DAG branch; no new DAG
mutation_policy.M2: TDD_REQUIRED: every production fix needs a failing regression first; additive tests/receipts are allowed; preserve exact RED/GREEN
mutation_policy.M3: HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: thermodynamic formula changes, unit convention changes, composition/Iphase/Nadd semantics, source parser/indexing, row ordering, tolerance widening, production API/solver callback/TOV/Cowling changes
mutation_policy.M4: PROTECTED: raw CompOSE EOS bytes, 52 source files, source-authority SHA, 65-pair identity, legacy outputs and C6/C6B provider-semantics blockers
mutation_policy.M5: SEPARATE_AUTHORIZATION: merge/release/deploy/provider contact/Dropbox upload or any remote action outside the specifically authorized PR branch updates

anti_drift_self_audit: Fetch exact live PR1 implementation head, PR3 source-authority head and PR4 DAG head before edits; record all three pins separately
Verify raw source files and canonical 65-pair manifest hashes are unchanged
Read native reconstruct_master, match_crust_core, construct_maxwell_transition and check_consistency before relying on notes
Use Euler mu_E=(epsilon+P)/n_B for Maxwell interpolation/root finding; do not use charge-shifted Il=0 Q3 as the root coordinate
Apply Il=0 Q3 relation mn*(1+Q3)=mu_E-Yq*mn*Q4 in validation and output; Il=1 equality only under Q5≈0
Keep the 2e-6 source/reconstruction Q3 threshold distinct from the 5e-4 true-Maxwell v1 kernel threshold
Keep historical smooth method=maxwell distinct from construct_maxwell_transition; the first has no density jump
Keep P(mu_E) root isolation exhaustive over every represented Hermite interval, including stationary/tangential roots; do not promote ambiguous/multiple roots
Prove stability and causality from interval extrema; 33-point samples are diagnostics only
Do not infer local neutrality, composition, Nadd, q_extra, Iphase or provider semantics from missing columns
No interpolation or derivative stencil crosses an Iphase discontinuity
No 65-pair roots/TOV/Cowling until C4-D0..D7 plus C4-D3R have all passed and C6B is resolved
Tests, collection counts, raw stdout, manifests and SHA256SUMS must describe the same exact source bytes
NOT_RUN/BLOCKED is retained for unavailable evidence; never promote a planned gate to PASS

validation_baseline.targeted_command: PYTHONPATH=python_frontend COMPOSE_EOS_FORTRAN_ROOT=. COMPOSE_EOS_FORTRAN_EXE=build/compose_eos_fortran/compose_eos_fortran python -m pytest -q python_frontend/tests pipeline/tests
